sentences.englishText: Want, neglect, confusion and misery in every shape and in every degree of intensity filled the endless corridors of the hospital.
sentences.turkishText: İstek, ihmal, kargaşa ve sefalet her şekilde ve her yoğunluk derecesinde hastanenin uçsuz bucaksız koridorlarını doldurmuştur.

sentences.englishText: The very building itself was shockingly defective.
sentences.turkishText: Binanın kendisi bile insanı şok edecek şekilde kusurludur.

sentences.englishText: The structural defects were equalled by the deficiencies in the commonest objects of hospital use.
sentences.turkishText: Yapısal bozukluklar hastanede kullanılan en yaygın nesnelerle bile eşit derecede kusurludur.

sentences.englishText: There were not enough bedsteads and the sheets were of canvas and very coarse.
sentences.turkishText: Yeterince karyola, çarşaf bezi bulunmuyordu ve çok kabaydı.
